user.title: Outdoor Brief
user.description:
The daily outdoor brief: tides for now, then marine weather, moon and garden in later versions. All tide data comes from the Marées France integration (SHOM), installed separately: Outdoor Brief never fetches it from the Internet itself.

Version 0.1 offers the coastal profile only. The garden profile (frost, rain, moon phase) comes in 0.5.

data_description.profile: What the brief is about. Garden and Both will appear here in a later version.

port.title: Port
port.description: Choose the Marées France port (one port = one Marées France device). Add another Outdoor Brief entry for each extra port.

data_description.port_device_id: Only devices created by the Marées France integration are listed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: These settings can be changed later from the integration options.

data_description.spring_tide_threshold: A day counts as a spring tide when its highest coefficient reaches this value. 100 is the usual convention; lower it to be told about strong tides more often (December 2026 peaks at 99, for example).
data_description.admin_notify_target: A notify.mobile_app_* service or a notify entity from the Companion app. Pre-filled with the phone already chosen in another SDR integration, if any. Used for notifications from version 0.3.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description:
Phone notifications use the admin phone chosen in the previous screen; the daily brief carries the summary image. The watch is optional and independent from the phone.

Apple Watch: iPhone notifications already show on the watch, leave the watch off to avoid duplicates. Wear OS: choose the watch's own notify service.

data_description.notify_frequency: Every day, only on remarkable days (today's coefficient reaches the spring tide threshold, or a spring tide within 2 days), or never. The spring tide alert (2 days before) is sent unless set to never.
data_description.notify_time: Time of the daily brief (Home Assistant time zone).
data_description.image_theme: Colours of the summary image attached to the phone notification.
data_description.watch_mode: Off; full notification (same text, no image, sent even without a phone); or short notice, sent only when the phone notification went through.
data_description.watch_notify_target: A notify service or entity of the watch, e.g. notify.mobile_app_galaxy_watch.

error.invalid_target: Enter a notify service or entity, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone.
error.watch_target_required: Choose the watch's notify target, or set the watch to Off.

abort.marees_france_missing: Outdoor Brief reads tides from the Marées France integration. Install it (HACS or Marketplace) and add at least one port first.
